title: Scope freeze
deliverable: Freeze the 1.0 reference commit, operation revisions, recipe schema, API and required browser profiles.
acceptance: Later upstream additions enter a separate backlog; security fixes remain eligible for inclusion.

title: Catalogue audit
deliverable: Independently reconcile every operation and argument against the pinned baseline and category/source inventories.
acceptance: No unexplained omissions, duplicate counting or native-only substitutions inflate the compatibility claim.

title: Workflow and UI audit
deliverable: Verify save/load, links, multiple inputs, breakpoints, offsets, Magic and complete control flow.
acceptance: Workbench parity is demonstrated beyond unit tests; safety differences are documented prominently.

title: Cross-target conformance
deliverable: Run native and actual Chromium, Firefox and WebKit suites with and without optional browser features.
acceptance: Required capabilities work on the published baseline; simulated wasm compilation alone is not sufficient.

title: Resource and denial-of-service audit
deliverable: Fuzz parsers, recipe compilation, regex, queries, archives, images and plugin host interfaces.
acceptance: Memory/work/depth/output limits hold; discovered crashes and hangs are triaged and fixed before release.

title: Unsafe and dependency audit
deliverable: Review unsafe islands, crypto providers, build scripts, generated tables and transitive dependency changes.
acceptance: No unreviewed dependency exception or known unmitigated high-severity issue remains in the release profile.

title: API and authorization assessment
deliverable: Exercise adversarial authentication, sessions, object permissions, uploads, egress and worker isolation.
acceptance: Confirmed critical/high findings are fixed and regression-tested; accepted lower risks have owners and rationale.

title: Data and cache assessment
deliverable: Verify secret handling, cache isolation, completed-artifact publication, deletion and backup behavior.
acceptance: Cross-tenant cache probing and partial-result disclosure tests fail closed; documentation matches actual retention.

title: Accessibility and usability assessment
deliverable: Test realistic tasks with keyboard, screen readers, high zoom, narrow layouts and error recovery.
acceptance: Essential tasks have non-canvas alternatives; accessibility failures are fixed rather than deferred to native apps.

title: Performance characterization
deliverable: Publish reference hardware/browser measurements for startup, interaction, throughput, memory and cancellation.
acceptance: Claims distinguish streaming from whole-input operations and cold from warm caches; no invented speedup multipliers.

title: Supply-chain release proof
deliverable: Produce dependency/asset manifests, license notices, signed checksums and reproducibility evidence for distributed artifacts.
acceptance: Independent clean builds can verify the release process; supplied models/fonts/data are licensed for redistribution.

title: Migration and disaster drill
deliverable: Re-run PostgreSQL/MySQL portability, schema upgrade/rollback and metadata/artifact restore on release candidates.
acceptance: Recovery preserves recipe revision and authorization invariants; operational instructions are executable.

title: Documentation and SDK freeze
deliverable: Finalize API reference, operation docs, extension guide, offline setup, threat model and migration contracts.
acceptance: Examples are exercised in CI; docs disclose compatibility limits and browser-owned TLS boundaries.

title: Release-candidate rehearsal
deliverable: Produce a feature-frozen candidate build and run the full acceptance checklist with representative users.
acceptance: Blocking issues produce further 0.x releases; the version number cannot waive missing functionality or security gates.

title: GA acceptance decision
deliverable: Assemble evidence for all mandatory capabilities, parity matrices, security, accessibility, recovery and provider boundaries.
acceptance: Advance to 1.0.0-rc only when every mandatory gate passes; otherwise continue 0.241.0 and beyond with concrete gap releases.
